newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sells PLN 980 mln T-bills at tender.
newsitem.headline: Poland sells PLN 980 mln T-bills at tender.

text.p: The minimum price of Poland's 13-week T-bill fell to 94.97 from last week's 94.98 at Monday's tender and the minimum price of the 39-week bill, offered for the first time in 1997, was at 85.98, the central bank said.
The treasury sold 980 million zlotys worth of bills after investors bid for 1.058 billion at the finance ministry's 1.1 billion zloty primary tender.
The ministry said it would stage an additional 600 million zloty primary tender on Wednesday, June 11, 1997.
NOTE. Offer and all bids in million zlotys. (*) The treasury will stage an additional tender on Wednesday, June 11, with a settlement date of Friday, June 13.
